notes: AWS DX and GCP Interconnect port fees do NOT vary by region — they are global list prices.
AWS bills in decimal GB (10^9 bytes). GCP bills in binary GiB (2^30 bytes). The calculator converts between them.
CCI Seoul availability confirmed for AWS via KINX Gasan and LG U+ POPs (aws-lgknx, aws-lgu57).
HA VPN option scales bandwidth via multiple tunnels + TGW ECMP on AWS side.
Per IPsec tunnel effective throughput ~1.25 Gbps (single flow); aggregate scales with ECMP.

aws_dx._comment: Both Option A and Option B use AWS Direct Connect Dedicated port on the AWS side.
aws_dx._dto_comment: Local DTO rate: traffic from ap-northeast-2 (Seoul Region) exiting via a Direct Connect location in Seoul (KINX Gasan / LG U+ Pyeongchon / Sejong IX).

ha_vpn._comment: GCP HA VPN + AWS Site-to-Site VPN. Bandwidth scales with tunnel count via TGW ECMP (>2 tunnels).

transfer_time._comment: Effective throughput ratio to nominal link speed. Interconnect ~85%, VPN per-tunnel already conservative at 1.25 Gbps.
